prompt: a red apple and a blue cup, realistic photo
text_key_denominator_note: all 512 model text positions, including padded positions used by FLUX

signals.joint: native P(target text-key span | image query), denominator is all 512 text + 2304 image keys
signals.text_only: diagnostic renormalization using the same FLUX Q/K logits but only 512 text keys; not native FLUX attention probability
signals.target_span_aggregation: sum token probabilities within each target word span, then mean over heads

apple.role: manual diagnostic annotation, not a layout target

cup.role: manual diagnostic annotation, not a layout target
